correctness.rationale: Proof enumerates every admissible spanning tree and uses the exact rank-two incidence update. Tree effective resistances and shared current path yield each Gram entry independently of deleted-edge positions; the positive generalized spectrum and smallest eigenvalue one follow from rank and n>=5. Strict one-variable monotonicity and exact radical factorization give the two distinct thresholds; the five-vertex equal-length Gram matrix proves minimality. A standalone checker replayed 152 grounded eigenspectrum/trace cases and seven symbolic identities. Finite tests are supplementary, not a proof for all parameters.

value.rationale: Tree preconditioners and stretch minimization are established numerical linear algebra tools; exact disagreement on the smallest eligible theta topology is a motivated structural benchmark. A continuous parameter interval with two distinct sharp crossings identifies precisely when a cheap combinatorial proxy selects the wrong tree, and the all-tree spectrum makes this a reusable calibration family. Not merely an arbitrary finite table or a claimed generic reversal; no runtime gain is asserted.
